reason: In logistics people buy from people they've shaken hands with at a fair or been referred to, and I won't let strangers in Sofia send cold emails in my company's name, even from separate domains. The new country isn't until next year, and EUR 5,000 with no meetings promised is a lot of money to bet that my name doesn't end up looking like spam.
objection: Cold outreach makes us look cheap and desperate, and I'm not convinced that 'we check each country's rules' would hold up if a German prospect filed a GDPR complaint. My reputation is the business, and a separate domain doesn't stop people seeing our company name.
would_change_my_mind: Two or three logistics or 3PL firms like mine, ideally in the country I'm entering, that I could call myself and that got real meetings from this without complaints, plus a written legal opinion on GDPR for that country.
